questions.stem: According to Fermat's little theorem, if $p$ is a prime and $a$ is an integer not divisible by $p$, what is $a^{p-1} \mod p$?
questions.explanation: Fermat's little theorem states that $a^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{p}$ for a prime $p$ and integer $a$ not divisible by $p$.

questions.stem: Calculate $7^{20} \mod 11$ using Fermat's little theorem. Provide your answer as an integer.
questions.explanation: Since 11 is prime and 7 is not divisible by 11, Fermat's little theorem gives $7^{10} \equiv 1 \pmod{11}$. Thus, $7^{20} = (7^{10})^2 \equiv 1^2 \equiv 1 \pmod{11}$.
